principle: Use only source stroke-weight ordering. Do not infer architectural meaning from line weight.

PUBLICATION.goal: Strengthen figure/ground hierarchy while retaining the complete source SVG.

TECHNICAL_CLEAN.goal: Clean source hierarchy with less contextual fading than publication mode.

SECTION_PRESENTATION_SAFE.goal: Increase existing heavy-line hierarchy for section communication without claiming heavy lines are cut geometry.
SECTION_PRESENTATION_SAFE.limitation: Semantic CUT styling requires explicit/verified section semantics.

promotion_rule: SOURCE_HEAVY must never be automatically renamed CUT/WALL/BOUNDARY without explicit semantic evidence.
